runners.comment: Hasn't progressed since handicapping; needs first-time cheekpieces to make difference
runners.name: Kathleen Mary
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden who hasn't progressed since moving into handicaps, beating only a couple home when sent off favourite over 1m4f here 13 days ago; first-time cheekpieces need to have a positive effect.

runners.comment: C&D win in December; ran with credit next three starts but well held here latest
runners.name: Bownder
runners.spotlight: C&D winner in December; posted creditable in-frame efforts on his next three outings but his run of good form came to a halt when well held over 1m4f here a fortnight ago.

runners.comment: Back on good mark but that's largely because he's been below par lately
runners.name: Youarenotforgiven
runners.spotlight: Won twice at Wolverhampton (9.4f) in the autumn but he's proved more miss than hit since; back on a good mark but comes with risks.

runners.comment: Stamina seemed to run out late when tacking 1m2f for first time at Chelmsford latest
runners.name: My Awele
runners.owner: Middleham Park Racing CII And Partners
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner at sprint trips; stays further but stamina seemed to run out late when tackling 1m2f for the first time at Chelmsford 19 days ago.

runners.comment: Well beaten both starts since December's 1m4f course success under Myla Coppins
runners.name: Upepo
runners.spotlight: Turned things around with a smooth success over 1m4f here under Myla Coppins in December but he's been beaten a long way on both outings since; bounce back needed.

runners.comment: Came with strong run from off pace to win over 1m4f here latest; player if as good at 1m2f
runners.name: Seventy
runners.spotlight: Third start for this yard when coming with a strong run from off the pace (also raced very wide off home turn) to win over 1m4f here 17 days ago; that performance can be marked up and he's likely to have a big say if as effective back at 1m2f.

runners.comment: Has largely struggled since 1m3f Tapeta win last spring
runners.name: Forca Timao
runners.spotlight: Easy winner of a Southwell handicap (1m3f, Tapeta) last spring but that was a four-runner race and he's struggled since; has plenty to prove.

runners.comment: Two good placed efforts over C&D since joining Laura Mongan; should figure again
runners.name: Beta Reader
runners.spotlight: It's now 12 runs since his sole victory but he's recorded two good placed efforts over C&D since joining Laura Mongan, going down by only a head latterly; has to enter calculations.

runners.comment: Mark in freefall but has failed to beat a rival in three AW runs this winter
runners.name: Under The Sun
runners.spotlight: His mark continues to tumble but he isn't giving any obvious indication he's likely to take advantage, failing to beat a rival on all three AW starts this winter.

runners.comment: Tricky customer but in good form over C&D lately, winning cosily latest; should go well
runners.name: Muy Muy Loco
runners.spotlight: Tricky customer but in good form over C&D lately, notably when sweeping from last (started slowly) to first three weeks ago; every chance of following up if in a similar mood, with a good chunk of his 4lb rise offset by Mason Paetel's claim.

runners.comment: Respectable efforts over 1m of late but his record is now 0-15
runners.name: Springbok
runners.owner: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd
runners.spotlight: 15-race maiden who has been performing respectably in 1m handicaps this winter without strongly suggesting his turn is near; today's longer trip needs to help him pull out a bit more.

runners.comment: Second in turf handicap last summer but absent for seven months ahead of this yard debut
runners.name: Qaaeadd
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in 7f Leicester handicap in cheekpieces for Paul Attwater last July; only fifth at Salisbury later that month and changed hands for 1,000gns in the autumn ahead of this first outing for a new yard after 216 days off; cheekpieces removed, first-time tongue-tie on.

14:12.race_name: BetMGM AWC 3 Year Old Trial Handicap

runners.comment: Needs to step up on reappearance effort and has the widest stall ahead of his stable debut
runners.name: Rogue Supremacy
runners.spotlight: Two wins as a 2yo and showed improvement switched to AW when a close second (third past the post) in a 6f Group 3 at Kempton last September (for David O'Meara); never really threatened at Newcastle six weeks ago and only dropped 1lb; has the widest stall to contend with starting out for Archie Watson (same owners).

runners.comment: Low-key effort at Newcastle on seasonal return; connections now reach for headgear
runners.name: Gold Queen Kindly
runners.spotlight: Low-key return to action at Newcastle six weeks ago; still has time to do better but connections have wasted little time reaching for headgear; wide draw for Polytrack debut.

runners.breeder: The Out Of The Flames Partnership
runners.comment: Easy C&D novice win on last month's return; another step forward needed in this field
runners.name: Star Of Albion
runners.spotlight: Promise as a 2yo and made short work of four rivals in a C&D novice on last month's return to action (blinkered first time); 4lb rise for that means he is 7lb higher than when second in a C&D nursery last September (only handicap run); improvement required but conditions clearly suit him well.

runners.comment: Two C&D wins in December; enhanced reputation with good second at Newcastle latest; solid
runners.name: Lord Harcourt
runners.spotlight: Returned from a gelding operation to win back-to-back C&D nurseries in December; came up just short in his hat-trick bid at Newcastle six weeks ago but it was another step forward in form terms; return to Lingfield should help and Ashley Lewis takes off a useful 5lb; good chance.

runners.comment: Up 16lb for his two impressive 5f wins here for new yard; up in trip; not fully exposed
runners.name: Henrythenate
runners.spotlight: Just one win from nine 2yo runs for Charlie Fellowes but he has been transformed by the addition of a tongue tie, producing a smart turn of foot to win back-to-back 5f handicaps here this year; whacked up 16lb for those victories but the manner of them suggests there could be more to come; now tackles 6f for the first time.

runners.comment: Two 6f wins at Southwell this year; 7lb rise in a more competitive race could find him out
runners.name: Mr Juggles
runners.spotlight: Improved run by run, getting off the mark in a 6f maiden at Southwell last month and following up at the same track on his handicap debut three weeks ago; still not fully exposed but a 7lb rise in a more demanding contest could leave him vulnerable.

runners.comment: 6f novice winner in November; solid h'cap form since but needs another step forward to win
runners.name: One And Gone
runners.spotlight: Won a 6f novice at Kempton on his stable debut in November; creditable efforts in handicaps since, notably his third in a similar event at Newcastle six weeks ago; tough task trying to dominate in today's field.

runners.comment: Returned from a break to win at Wolverhampton last month; up 3lb in a deeper race
runners.name: Saffron Dandy
runners.spotlight: Made a winning 2yo debut before struggling in a Group 3/sales race afterwards; returned from a break to win a 6f handicap at Wolverhampton last month; not fully exposed but a 3lb rise in a deeper race could leave her vulnerable.

runners.comment: Made all to beat red-hot favourite at Wolverhampton 25 days ago; tough task on h'cap debut
runners.name: Horace Wallace
runners.spotlight: Improved with each run in maiden/novice company, lowering the colours of the red-hot favourite at Wolverhampton 25 days ago; enjoyed the run of the race on that occasion and he makes his handicap debut in a good race.

runners.comment: Had a fine year but up in the weights and looks to face a tough task in this field
runners.name: Grey Horizon
runners.spotlight: Four 6f wins on Tapeta this year but he is up in the weights as a result; looks up against it at this level.

runners.comment: Ended 2yo campaign with an easy Nottingham win (6f, heavy); 9lb higher for return
runners.name: Startled
runners.spotlight: Progressive 2yo, rounding off that campaign with a ready win in a 6f nursery (heavy) at Nottingham four months ago; more to do off what is effectively a 9lb higher mark and he will find easier pickings as the year goes on.

runners.comment: 5f win at Wolverhampton in December; fair 3rd here last time but opposable from 4lb wrong
runners.name: U S S Charleston
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the eighth attempt when winning a small-field nursery at Wolverhampton in December; solid third here two weeks ago but he has more on his plate from 4lb out of the weights.

14:42.race_name: BetMGM AWC Fillies And Mares Trial Handicap

runners.comment: Two AW wins for Ed Walker; sold 40,000gns since latest run; not fully exposed; contender
runners.name: Bridgets View
runners.spotlight: Two wins from six starts for Ed Walker, both on AW (7f, Polytrack and 1m, Tapeta); not at her best at Newcastle five weeks ago but this is effectively a drop in grade (despite being a Class 2) and she is back against her own sex; could resume her progress for new stable (sold for 40,000gns this month).

runners.comment: On a good mark and this year's two runs both better than the finishing position suggests
runners.name: Powdering
runners.spotlight: On a good mark on last season's best and two runs this year have been more encouraging than the finishing positions suggest; could go well.

runners.comment: C&D winner; won three of her last five starts but perhaps a bit high in the weights now
runners.name: Brazilian Rose
runners.spotlight: Three wins from her last five starts; only third of four behind Mereside Diva at Newcastle 13 days ago but that tactical event wouldn't have played to her strengths; drawn wide but this C&D winner is likely to be dropped in; high in the weights now though.

runners.comment: C&D win last Good Friday was a fine effort; shaped nicely here in December; can do better
runners.name: Lady Manzor
runners.spotlight: Three wins in the first half of 2025, two of them over C&D with the latest in a valuable prize on Good Friday; only fifth over C&D when last seen on New Year's Eve but that race wasn't run to suit; leaves the impression she still has a bigger effort in her when things pan out favourably.

runners.comment: Back to winning ways in blinkers two weeks ago (7f, Tapeta); new mark still manageable
runners.name: Mereside Diva
runners.spotlight: Good second at Southwell last month and she returned to winning ways in a small field at Newcastle (7f; first-time blinkers) two weeks ago; a 3lb rise shouldn't handicap her out of things given 2025 peak.

runners.comment: Good winner at Wolverhampton in December; has run okay twice since; fast pace would suit
runners.name: Enola Grey
runners.spotlight: Came from off the pace to win a 7f handicap at Wolverhampton in fine style in December; beaten twice since but she hasn't run badly; fully exposed but a strong pace would enhance her claims.

runners.comment: Conditions to suit and arrives on the back of a personal best; needs more now up in class
runners.name: Penelope Valentine
runners.spotlight: Three wins, including C&D, since joining James Owen last summer; far too strong for her five rivals at Wolverhampton last month (8.6f) but that was only Class 5 and she will need more to follow up in this stronger race off a 6lb higher mark.

runners.comment: Struggled in handicaps after early promise; hooded now stepping back up in trip; not solid
runners.name: Cartwheel
runners.spotlight: 7f novice winner as a 2yo; struggled in three handicap runs, including last of seven at Wolverhampton (5f) on her return to action two weeks ago; edging down the weights but the addition of a hood isn't enough to tempt.

runners.comment: Running well this year but the new trip/headgear needs to prompt a bit more
runners.name: Ziggys Queen
runners.spotlight: Ended 2025 with a 6f win at Wolverhampton and she has been placed in her three runs this year; sneaking up the weights and now tackles 7f for the first time; new hood joins usual tongue tie.

runners.comment: C&D win last month; saddle slipped latest; one to consider
runners.name: Party Bear
runners.spotlight: C&D winner last month; latest Newcastle run easy to excuse as the saddle slipped early on; unexposed in cheekpieces but she will need to step up a notch to take this.

runners.comment: Good win at Wolverhampton last month; up 3lb but apprentice takes off a valuable 5lb
runners.name: Bear Rock
runners.spotlight: Career-best effort when winning a 7f handicap at Wolverhampton last month; up 3lb but could be capable of better at this trip; Ashley Lewis's 5lb claim a bonus.

runners.comment: 10lb higher than for his win in the 2025 renewal but he's earned this mark; high on list
runners.name: Ferrous
runners.spotlight: He was returning from a 147-day break when readily accounting for eight rivals in the corresponding event 12 months ago; 10lb higher this time around but he has earned his lofty rating; close fourth in a Listed event here four weeks ago; contender.

runners.comment: Unbeaten in three AW runs and improving all the time; another big run looks on the cards
runners.name: El Bodon
runners.spotlight: 3-3 on AW, showing improved form to win a useful race at Kempton 16 days ago (6f); 3lb rise not beyond him and he should give it a good go in his hat-trick bid.

runners.comment: Two fine runs since reverting to 6f, doing well from wide draw latest; unexposed at trip
runners.name: Lakers
runners.spotlight: Two fine runs since dropped back to 6f, winning easily at Southwell in October and running well from a wide stall back there on New Year's Day; not fully exposed and he is high on the list.

runners.comment: Won first time out in both seasons of racing; gelded since last seen; still unexposed
runners.name: Fast Track Harry
runners.spotlight: Won two of his first three starts and he made a fine start to his handicap career when second of 18 at York last June (6f, good to firm); two lesser efforts at Ascot followed but he has been gelded over the winter and still has potential for a yard that excels with this type; successful first time out in each of his two seasons of racing.

runners.comment: On a good mark and his reappearance was promising; contender despite the widest stall
runners.name: Sergeant Wilko
runners.spotlight: Excelled as a 3yo but found the handicapper in command last year; promising reappearance at Newcastle six weeks ago (first run after wind surgery) and he is on a dangerous mark; widest stall to deal with but foolish to discount.

runners.comment: Promising 2yo; absent since June and makes his comeback in a useful event
runners.name: An Outlaws Grace
runners.spotlight: Useful 2yo; only seen twice last year, showing better form when third (beaten 3.5l) in a Class 3 at Newmarket 251 days ago; returns to action in a good race and may come on for this.

runners.comment: Four wins over further; solid 3rd at Newcastle latest; up in class & may prove vulnerable
runners.name: Little Empire
runners.spotlight: All four wins have come over further; in good form on AW this winter, most recently finishing a close third at Newcastle (7f; cheekpieces first time) three weeks ago; more on his plate in this grade.

15:45.race_name: Midnite AWC Marathon Trial Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.breeder: S C E A Marmion Vauville Et Al
runners.comment: Had three of these behind him when second on Wolverhampton reappearance; should go well
runners.name: Roaring Legend
runners.spotlight: Developed into a useful handicapper on the Flat for Hugo Palmer last year; having rejoined Olly Murphy, he continued the good work when second on 2m Wolverhampton reappearance three weeks ago, with reopposing pair Enemy and Brasil Power narrowly behind in third/fourth; likely to go well again.

runners.comment: Smart in prime but not so good lately, including behind three of these last time
runners.name: Prydwen
runners.spotlight: Productive on AW/turf in 2024 but draw a blank in 2025 and behind three of these rivals when last of six at Wolverhampton (2m) three weeks ago; others are more obvious.

runners.comment: Good fourth in 1m6f Glorious Goodwood handicap off similar mark last year; AW debut
runners.name: Duraji
runners.spotlight: All nine starts on turf; best effort last year when fourth of 14 in 1m6f Glorious Goodwood handicap off 1lb higher in August; well held in 2m Curragh Group 3 and 1m7f French Listed event when last seen in November; hooded first time on return.

runners.breeder: Ecurie Des Monceaux & Skymarc Farm Inc
runners.comment: Closely matched with Roaring Legend and Brasil Power on latest Wolverhampton form
runners.name: Enemy
runners.spotlight: Still very useful at the age of nine, getting his head back in front at Southwell (1m4f) on New Year's Day; split reopposing pair Roaring Legend and Brasil Power when creditable third of six over 2m at Wolverhampton three weeks ago but he has yet to win over this trip.

runners.comment: Three wins at up to 1m4f in December and creditable in-frame efforts over 2m since
runners.name: Brasil Power
runners.spotlight: Versatile sort whose record of 7-28 on AW includes wins over 1m and 1m4f (twice) in December; creditable in-frame efforts over 2m at Newcastle and Wolverhampton since and he ought to be competitive again.

runners.comment: Saw off Enemy at Kempton in October but has struggled twice since
runners.name: Sheradann
runners.spotlight: Saw off reopposing stablemate Enemy when successful over 2m at Kempton in October but down the field in a series final there at the beginning of December and eased off after hanging left under pressure at Newcastle last month; hard to know what to expect.

runners.comment: Low-mileage 4yo who is an interesting contender on return for leading yard
runners.name: Anniversary
runners.spotlight: Has shown plenty of promise in a light career; absent since finishing fifth of ten in a useful 3yo handicap at Doncaster (extended 1m6f) last June; faded in the closing stages on that occasion having raced freely in first-time blinkers and the headgear is discarded on his return; AW debut; very interesting contender, particularly if backed.

runners.comment: Given chance by handicapper but struggled over hurdles lately; plenty to prove
runners.name: Peking Opera
runners.owner: S Packham A Austin And B Austin
runners.spotlight: Listed Flat winner for Aidan O'Brien; successful hurdle debut for this yard in early 2024 but he's found life tough under both codes since; given a chance by the handicapper (ran off 15lb higher when last seen on the Flat in October 2024) but pulled up over hurdles earlier in the month and could only consider if backed.

runners.comment: Largely progressive and big player if stamina holds up in trip.
runners.name: Solarize
runners.owner: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum
runners.spotlight: All six starts on AW, winning 1m2f Chelmsford novice and 1m4f Wolverhampton handicap in the autumn; only fifth at Chelmsford next time but resumed his progression when second of eight over 1m3f at Kempton nine days ago; that appeals as solid form and he's likely to have a big say off the same mark (2lb higher from Saturday) if his stamina holds over this significantly longer trip (pedigree provides hope).

16:20.race_name: Midnite AWC Middle Distance Trial Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.comment: Excellent AW record but only fifth off this lofty mark at Kempton latest
runners.name: Kings Code
runners.spotlight: Smart handicapper who had Beylerbeyi behind in third when registering his tenth AW success at Newcastle (1m2f) in January; raised to a triple-figure rating for the first time on the back of that and faded into fifth (Beylerbeyi second) over 1m3f at Kempton since; Laura Coughlan takes 3lb off his back this time but he might still prove vulnerable for win purposes.

runners.comment: Good record since joining Ralph Beckett but may find this test on the sharp side
runners.name: Lord Melbourne
runners.spotlight: 2024 November Handicap winner who reappeared with an easy win over 1m2f at Epsom last September; respectable sixth of 22 when bidding to defend his November Handicap crown on sole subsequent start last year; well-beaten fifth on the snow at St Moritz on return last weekend; entitled to come on for that outing but this test might be sharp enough for him.

runners.comment: Cesarewitch winner but by no means just a stayer, going close over 1m3f latest; player
runners.name: Beylerbeyi
runners.spotlight: Ended 2025 with a win in the Cesarewitch (2m2f) but his very good placed efforts over 1m2f at Newcastle (third to King's Code) and 1m3f at Kempton (close second) this year show he's by no means just a stayer; the hood he's worn on last three starts is left off here; should go well.

runners.comment: Struggled in Dubai last month but well treated if return to Britain sparks revival
runners.name: Flight Plan
runners.owner: Fine Clarets Racing Tp Watson & C Wood
runners.spotlight: Often front runs; below par in three outings at Meydan last month (including dirt) but well treated if a return to Britain sparks a revival having landed last year's Thirsk Hunt Cup off 6lb higher; Tapeta winner at the start of his career.

runners.comment: C&D win in December; third in C&D Listed race since but form might be muddling; drawn wide
runners.name: Dukes Command
runners.spotlight: Up to this trip for the first time when winning a 0-105 handicap over C&D in December; bettered that form when third in a steadily run C&D Listed event on New Year's Day; nicely treated if that effort is taken at face value but his outside draw could be tricky.

runners.comment: Too keen when 6-4 for 13-runner race on return but evidently well regarded; hood back on
runners.name: Regal Ulixes
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who was all the rage in the betting (6-4) for a similar race at Newcastle on his reappearance but faded into sixth of 13 behind King's Code having raced too keenly; that market strength suggests his leading yard believes him to be on a good mark and he may prove the point if settling better in a refitted hood.

runners.comment: Made it six wins in last eight AW starts when getting up late over C&D latest; only up 2lb
runners.name: Wyld Bill
runners.spotlight: Record in AW handicaps since last June reads 511215111; finished strongly from the rear to collar Qitaal (who finished third) near the line and shade a blanket finish over C&D last time; has to enter calculations again off only 2lb higher.

runners.comment: Went close at York on final start last year but behind a few of these on reappearance
runners.name: Dark Moon Rising
runners.spotlight: Hit and miss these days but on a good day when emerging from the rear to nearly win a big-field handicap at York over an extended 1m2f on his final 6yo start; finished behind a few of these on his Newcastle reappearance, though.

runners.comment: Encouraging reappearance when third to Wyld Bill over C&D; player if in same form
runners.name: Qitaal
runners.spotlight: Has managed only one win in his last 24 starts but he's had very little racing on AW and made an encouraging return from six months off when third of 12 to Wyld Bill over C&D 17 days ago, overhauled only late on having travelled strongly and hit the front turning for home; player if in similar form.

runners.comment: Feasibly treated and should be sharper for return but this is a rise in class
runners.name: Bubbles Wonky
runners.spotlight: Winner of a maiden and handicap on turf during his time with Tim Easterby; entitled to strip fitter for last month's AW/stable debut at Chelmsford and he's dipped to 1lb below his win mark.

runners.comment: Ascot win in July but hasn't beaten a rival in two AW runs this winter
runners.name: Trojan Storm
runners.spotlight: 1m6f turf win at Ascot last July but not seen again until failing to beat a rival in two AW handicaps this winter; Beylerbeyi has to be considered the yard first string.

runners.comment: Still useful aged eight and ran creditably on Wednesday when bidding for a Kempton double
runners.name: Popmaster
runners.spotlight: Still useful aged eight and ran creditably (dropped back to 7f) on Wednesday when bidding for a Kempton double, taking form figures this year to 3212; solid contender who may well remain competitive.

runners.comment: Brings respectable form; possibilities with Jack Callan taking off 5lb
runners.name: Apiarist
runners.spotlight: Made the frame in a few notable handicaps on AW and turf last term; respectable fourth, amid traffic issues, at Newcastle (1m) on reappearance; remains above last winning mark but Jack Callan takes off 5lb; possibilities.

runners.comment: Scored under Hector Crouch on reappearance last term; interesting
runners.name: Superposition
runners.spotlight: Developed into a useful sort last season, particularly on AW, winning twice in the spring (including under Hector Crouch on reappearance) and running well in a few Class 2 handicaps; interesting on seasonal debut.

runners.comment: All wins at 7f but latest effort suggests this return to 1m is worth a go
runners.name: Legal Reform
runners.spotlight: Has registered all wins over 7f and in lower grades; however, ran respectably in Lingfield Class 2 most recently, while shaping as if this return to 1m is worth a go; whether he can defy current mark is another matter.

runners.comment: The amount of ability he retains is not clear; second run for new yard
runners.name: Diderot
runners.spotlight: Never on terms when a 50-1 shot at Southwell (7f) on stable/seasonal debut, having been absent for almost a year; return to 1m looks a plus but the amount of ability he retains is not clear.

runners.comment: Has recent course form (7f) and this return to 1m is worth exploring
runners.name: Tiger Crusade
runners.spotlight: Form this year features two good performances over 7f at Lingfield, getting up in the finish in January and running-on second last time; looks worth this belated return to 1m and remains well treated on historical data.

runners.comment: Remains of interest, assuming he settles better back down in trip
runners.name: Eupator
runners.owner: Middleham Park Racing I and Partner
runners.spotlight: Paid the price for going too freely in front last time (9.5f) when failing to complete a Wolverhampton hat-trick; gained his two wins in good style and, assuming he settles better back down in trip, remains of interest.

runners.comment: May yet confirm the form of reappearance win; not written off
runners.name: North View
runners.spotlight: Contrasting performances (over 7f) this year for new yard, winning with a bit in hand at Chelmsford then disappointing at Southwell; may yet confirm the form of reappearance win and can't be written off; stays 1m.

runners.comment: Hindered by steady pace last time; progressive otherwise on AW
runners.name: High On Hope
runners.spotlight: Hindered by the steady pace (failed to settle) at Kempton last time when bidding for a 1m hat-trick; steadily progressive otherwise on AW and may do better still; not dismissed, assuming this pans out favourably.

runners.comment: Still a maiden but receives plenty of weight all round; could go well
runners.name: Sheikh Raj
runners.spotlight: Has some encouraging form, notably close second over C&D (Class 5) on penultimate start; the only maiden in this field and steps up in grade but receives plenty of weight all round; could go well.

14:00.race_name: West Berkshire Mencap Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Drew clear of the others with progressive rival when scoring at Kempton this month
runners.name: Guchen
runners.spotlight: Scored under Aamilah Aswat at Kempton (2m5f, good to soft) this month, drawing clear of the others with a progressive rival; 6lb higher here but, after only eight hurdle runs, further progress is possible; tongue-tie added.

runners.comment: Won small-field maiden on British debut and didn't run badly in a handicap last time
runners.name: Calme Olympien
runners.spotlight: Ex-French 7yo who won three-runner Ffos Las maiden (2m4f, good) on British debut in October and didn't run badly when last of four finishers in Sandown handicap (2m4f, heavy) last month, albeit finishing tired; back on a less testing surface here; no surprise if he features.

runners.comment: Won two of his last three but may find younger rivals better handicapped here
runners.name: Our Dylan
runners.spotlight: In-form 10yo who has won two of his last three; raised another 4lb since scoring under a good 7lb claimer at Taunton (2m3f, heavy) this month, though, and may find younger rivals better handicapped here.

runners.breeder: E U R L Agb Agency & Mrs D Billebaut
runners.comment: Third in Ffos Las maiden last month; should have more improvement to come in handicaps
runners.name: Karma Police
runners.spotlight: Irish point winner who posted his most encouraging of three runs over hurdles when third in Ffos Las (2m4f, heavy) in January latest; unraced on ground faster than soft but should have more improvement to come in handicaps.

runners.comment: 40-1 second in Doncaster novice in November but well held since; improvement needed
runners.name: Caliach Point
runners.spotlight: Belied 40-1 odds when second in Doncaster novice (2m, soft) in November but was no threat to the easy winner there and tailed off next time; back up in trip for handicap debut; opening mark demands improvement.

runners.comment: Placed over 2m on first two hurdling starts but well held in 2m3f handicap since
runners.name: Super Freddie
runners.spotlight: Placed over 2m on first two hurdling starts but dropped out rather tamely after making the running on handicap debut at Haydock (2m3f, good to soft) in December and arrives here with a point to prove.

runners.comment: Ex-Irish maiden; makes handicap debut after long absence but is hugely unexposed
runners.name: Hackney Hill
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten in three Irish maiden hurdles (2m-2m4f) for Edward O'Grady in 2024 and makes stable/handicap debut after a 425-day absence; however, he's hugely unexposed and will need to be taken very seriously if strong in the betting; tongue-tie added.

runners.comment: Ran well in defeat at Plumpton this month and new jockey claims a useful 6lb
runners.name: Activist
runners.spotlight: Four-time hurdle winner; bounced back from a poor run when second at Plumpton (2m4f, soft; tongue-tie refitted) this month and new jockey Rian Corcoran claims a useful 6lb; shortlisted.

runners.comment: Placed over 2m at Punchestown last month and might be better suited by today's trip
runners.name: Couldntmakeitup
runners.spotlight: Irish raider; 0-10 over hurdles but gave a pretty good account when third at Punchestown (2m, soft to heavy) last month and could be better suited by today's trip-and-ground combination; might be the answer.

runners.comment: Won run-of-the-mill maiden in spring 2024; makes handicap debut after long absence
runners.name: El Curamach
runners.spotlight: Justified odds-on favouritism in run-of-the-mill Warwick maiden (2m, good) in May 2024 but this handicap debut comes after a mammoth absence and he'll be of interest only if lively in the betting.

runners.comment: Did not get competitive in three maiden/novice hurdles; up in trip for handicap debut
runners.name: Boston Savr
runners.spotlight: Did not get competitive in three maiden/novice hurdles (1m7f-2m) in December/January and does not look well treated for this handicap debut, but combination of new trip and first-time cheekpieces may enable improvement.

runners.comment: Won on heavy ground last month but was a disappointing favourite on latest outing
runners.name: Osterberg
runners.spotlight: Displayed improvement to score on heavy ground at Ffos Las (2m6f) last month but raced too freely and was a disappointing favourite when well-held third at Lingfield (2m7f, heavy) three weeks ago; others appeal more.

runners.comment: Returned from long absence with a heavy defeat in small field on Boxing Day
runners.name: No Mean Feat
runners.spotlight: Returned from long absence with a heavy defeat in small field at Fontwell on Boxing Day and is now 0-12 over hurdles; 2lb wrong here and has a lot more to prove than some of these.

14:30.race_name: BetVictor Simple Things Juvenile Hurdle (Novices' Championship Hurdle Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Showed plenty of ability in France and came good in a heavy-ground maiden at Taunton
runners.name: Innamorato
runners.spotlight: Made a quiet start for this yard but he showed plenty of ability in France and came good in a heavy-ground maiden at Taunton (2m3f); it's unlikely that he needs that sort of ground, and he could progress further; penalised.

runners.comment: French winner; underwhelming so far in Britain and a BHA mark of 120 looks flattering
runners.name: Mojito Des Mottes
runners.spotlight: A bit underwhelming in his two British runs (good/good to soft) and again he's burdened with a penalty for his win in France; looks very flattered by a BHA mark of 120 but it will be disappointing if he can't do better for his powerful connections.

runners.comment: Best of his four Flat runs was a fourth of nine on the AW (1m4f novice; fair form)
runners.name: Bowling Shane
runners.spotlight: Best of his four Flat runs was a fourth of nine on the AW (1m4f novice; fair form) when beaten under 5l; has some ability and stable had a recent juvenile hurdle winner, but he's not the obvious answer.

runners.comment: 0-4 on the Flat; joined a leading yard for jumps action but that's the principal positive
runners.name: Ettore
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late John Connolly
runners.spotlight: Well-bred colt but 0-4 in these colours for Roger Varian and the latest third in a 1m novice at Windsor in August is nothing to shout about; has joined a leading yard for jumps action but that's the principal positive.

runners.comment: Flat maiden and beaten 22l and 64l in two races over hurdles at this track
runners.name: Laplander
runners.owner: A Lofts C & R Russell & Partner
runners.spotlight: Maiden who had plenty of chances on the Flat and has been beaten 22l and 64l in two races over hurdles at this track; admittedly, he was never going to mix it with Sober Glory last time, but probably one for handicaps.

runners.comment: Flat winner over 1m4f; the form of his second at Warwick has worked out well
runners.name: Love You Back
runners.spotlight: No great shakes on the Flat (1-11) but he did win his final run in that scene over 1m4f at Brighton in September (good to firm; also runner-up on soft); failed favourite backers when second on hurdling debut (Warwick; 2m, good) but the winner has since progressed to better things; absent since November but his yard has won two of the last four renewals of this; player.

runners.comment: This is no easy introduction and breeding suggests he's a long-term prospect
runners.name: Mistral St Georges
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to winners Georges Saint (2m3f-2m5f chase) and Kobalt St Georges (2m1f-2m5f hurdle); dam once-raced half-sister to useful 2m hurdle/chase winner Bon Papa; a watching brief is probably best.

runners.comment: It was a low-grade 2m AW handicap he won last month; others appeal more
runners.name: Rogue Justice
runners.spotlight: Back from a break to get off the mark on the Flat last month (sixth attempt), albeit in a low-grade 2m handicap on the AW; has the stamina for hurdling and Sean Bowen is booked, but others are still preferred.

runners.comment: Fairly useful Flat form and not beaten far on her switch to hurdles at Kempton; player
runners.name: Cecilia Star
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced for Michael Bell but won a 1m2f AW maiden and was close up in a Goodwood handicap; that Flat form is the best on show here and it was an encouraging start over hurdles when not beaten far in a maiden for mares at Kempton (staying on; good to soft); considered.

runners.comment: Third in a Grade 1 latest; every chance he'll give weight and a beating to these
runners.name: Miami Magic
runners.spotlight: Fine on good and soft ground; Grade 1 placed over hurdles and this Cheltenham chase winner did well to finish within 7l of the smart Sixmilebridge in the Grade 1 Scilly Isles at Sandown (2m4f) as he can jump a lot better than he did that day on soft ground; every chance that he'll be able to give weight and a beating to these, provided he stays this longer trip.

runners.comment: Should win again sooner or later but today's terms are not favourable
runners.name: Elysian Knight
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdle winner; pulled up on chase debut and again wasn't foot-perfect over his fences when runner-up at Musselburgh (2m4f, good to soft; had subsequent Listed winner behind); should win again sooner or later but today's terms are not favourable.

runners.comment: Might be sharper after recent chase debut but faces a tricky task at the weights
runners.name: Thank You Maam
runners.owner: The Posh Pundit Racing Club Limited
runners.spotlight: Useful winning hurdler who stays this far and seems able on most ground; recent remote third on chase debut was after a lengthy break and in useful company; might well be all the sharper here but faces a tricky task at the weights.

runners.breeder: Mrs P Bailey And Miss S Bailey
runners.comment: Five-time hurdle winner who won her first chase; had wind operation since remote on latest
runners.name: Wyenot
runners.spotlight: Five-time hurdle winner with a good strike-rate, one she enhanced when prevailing in a classy small-field beginners' chase at Ludlow (3m, good); remote last of three in a Listed chase for mares at Warwick where soft ground was no good to her (fine on good to soft); has since had wind surgery and retains potential as a chaser.

runners.comment: Now has a good bit to prove over fences but her hurdling form has to be respected
runners.name: Thats Nice
runners.spotlight: Irish pointer who went 2-3 in novice hurdles; it's been a quiet start as a chaser (2m3f handicaps) and she didn't really take a cut at her fences last time at Doncaster (in first-time cheekpieces, now removed); now has a bit to prove but her hurdling form has to be respected.

15:35.race_name: BetVictor Watch Weekend Winners "National Hunt" Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Scopey 6yo who was an impressive winner of his hurdle debut at Taunton
runners.name: Talk To The Man
runners.spotlight: Paul Nicholls has won three of the last five runnings of this race; this Irish point winner (good to yielding) left his bumper form behind when comfortably accounting for his penalised market rival in a 2m3f novice at Taunton (heavy); it's difficult to know how good he might be and he commands considerable respect.

runners.comment: Maiden winner in Ireland and has a big shout on his second in a Grade 3 there
runners.name: The Big Clubman
runners.spotlight: Irish challenger with an Albert Bartlett entry at Cheltenham; won maiden at Wexford on good ground and stayed on well from off pace to be second in a 2m4f Grade 3 at Navan (heavy); latest run in a Grade 2 wasn't so clever, but that was over 2m7f and it turned into a sprint finish; nice prospect.

runners.comment: Point winner; 80-1 for hurdle debut at Doncaster and ended up tailed off
runners.name: Agent Argylle
runners.spotlight: Irish point winner; shaped okay behind a smart winner in a bumper at Wetherby but still went off at 80-1 for hurdle debut at Doncaster and ended up tailed off.

runners.comment: Capable of winning a novice hurdle but has to raise his game against this opposition
runners.name: Big Bert
runners.spotlight: Point winner and runner-up in a bumper and a maiden hurdle, though was beaten 16l on that latter occasion and inherited second place; brought down at the first last time; has to raise his game against this opposition.

runners.comment: Ffos Las last time was a backward step but heavy ground there doesn't suit all horses
runners.name: Buddy Holly
runners.owner: Mrs Paul Shanahan & Mrs John Magnier
runners.spotlight: Looked to have a future when shaping well in an Irish bumper (good to yielding) and a C&D novice (soft); Ffos Las last time was a backward step but heavy ground there doesn't suit all horses; remains of interest.

runners.breeder: M Devilder & Earl Les Obeaux DAnjou
runners.comment: Lightly raced 5yo who should improve, but it's very much needed
runners.name: Laurier Des Obeaux
runners.spotlight: Made an encouraging start over hurdles at Lingfield (2m3f, good to soft) and it was a better race when beaten 18l here in December; should improve, but it's needed.

runners.comment: Has struggled in two maiden hurdles following a long absence; stable second string
runners.name: Mulinas
runners.spotlight: Beat Potters Charm in an Irish point; two bumper runs were okay but he has struggled in two maiden hurdles following a long absence; looks the clear stable second string.

16:08.race_name: Highclere Horse Feeds Oataalin Handicap Chase (For The Geoffrey Gilbey Trophy) (GBB Race)

runners.breeder: S C P Haras Des Coudraies
runners.comment: It's surprising to see cheekpieces back on but he has a big effort in him off this mark
runners.name: Kotmask
runners.spotlight: Resurgent in first-time blinkers when second to an improver at Sandown in January (good; fine on soft) and fell midrace back there last time; it's surprising to see cheekpieces back on (beaten 10l in December when tried in them once before) but he has a big effort in him off this mark.

runners.comment: Due a 3lb rise in future after going close under Isabelle Ryder at Carlisle 11 days ago
runners.name: Hardy Du Seuil
runners.spotlight: Won over hurdles in November and has done well on his belated return to fences, following his fourth at Haydock with a near miss at Carlisle (2m, good to soft); Isabelle Ryder again claims her 5lb and this 9yo is up 3lb in future.

runners.comment: Left clear when beating an exposed veteran at Southwell but this 6yo is far from exposed
runners.name: Daytime Dreaming
runners.spotlight: Left clear when beating an exposed veteran at Southwell (2m, good to soft) but this 6yo hasn't had much racing over hurdles or fences so he's probably on the upgrade; an 8lb rise might not be the end of the world.

runners.comment: Two wins and a second to show from his completed starts over fences; up 4lb for last time
runners.name: Pure Carbon
runners.spotlight: Two wins and a second to show from his completed starts over fences and he went up only 4lb for the Musselburgh success a month ago (2m, good to soft); this is only his 11th career start, so firmly in calculations.

runners.comment: Best form going left handed; won this last year; raced at right-handed Sandown latest
runners.name: Rath Gaul Hill
runners.spotlight: Returning from an absence when edging home in this 12 months ago off 2lb higher; his penultimate effort (here in first-time cheekpieces) was respectable and it's perhaps best to forget Sandown last time when his best form has been on left-handed tracks; respected.

runners.breeder: E A R L Haras De Saint-Vincent
runners.comment: Could need this after such a long absence but he's well handicapped
runners.name: First Angel
runners.spotlight: Sean Bowen was also aboard when this 10yo made it 3-10 over fences at Taunton 13 months ago (2m, good to soft) on second run back from 478 days off; he needed the first and that may again be the case here, after 405 days off, but he's well handicapped.

16:43.race_name: Cheltenham Specials Made Simple At BetVictor Handicap Hurdle (Challenger Stayers Hurdle Series Qual)

runners.comment: Won four times last season but yet to strike form after four chase/hurdle runs this term
runners.name: Tiny Tetley
runners.owner: R J Hodges & Mrs S L Hobbs
runners.spotlight: Won four times over hurdles last season (2m7f-3m) but chasing didn't go to plan in the autumn and he was soundly beaten when back over hurdles on Boxing Day; needs to get career back on track.

runners.comment: Low-mileage 7yo; ended 2025 in good form at around 2m4f; big player on first 3m attempt
runners.name: Peacenik
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 7yo who left low-key seasonal debut behind when scoring by just over 5l at Doncaster (2m3f, good to soft) in December and again ran well when placed here (2m4f, good) later that month; open to improvement on first attempt at 3m; must be considered seriously.

runners.comment: Won two small-field chases this season (both 2m4f, heavy); faces different test here
runners.name: Big City Roller
runners.spotlight: 2-3 over fences this season, with both wins gained in four-runner 2m4f races on heavy ground (cheekpieces added last time); faces a different test on this return to hurdling but could have untapped potential over 3m.

runners.comment: Good winner at Warwick on New Year's Eve but below that form since; new PB needed
runners.name: Benign Dictator
runners.spotlight: 3-15 over hurdles, latest win at Warwick (3m2f, good to soft) on New Year's Eve; below form on latest outing, though, and needs to bounce back with career-best effort here; cheekpieces (absent this term) are refitted.

runners.comment: Player if judged on last season's C&D hurdle form; disappointing over fences this term
runners.name: Magical King
runners.spotlight: Consistent over hurdles last season, with best effort a C&D second (soft) just over a year ago; disappointing over fences this term (three attempts; blinkers tried last time) and this switch back to hurdling needs to rekindle his enthusiasm; usual cheekpieces back on today.

runners.comment: Pulled up on last three chase/hurdle runs; big leap of faith is required to support him
runners.name: Champagne Twist
runners.spotlight: Very promising novice during 2023-24 season but generally very disappointing over last two campaigns; pulled up on last three chase/hurdle runs (cheekpieces added last time); big leap of faith required to support him.

runners.comment: 2-4 since returned to hurdling but this is tougher than the mares' race she won this month
runners.name: Jalisco Star
runners.spotlight: 2-4 since returned to hurdling in the autumn, the latter win gained in four-runner mares' race at Chepstow (2m7f, soft) a fortnight ago; evidently in very good nick but has quite a bit more on her plate here.

runners.comment: Ran as though something was amiss in latest chase; a possible if back on song here
runners.name: Fierce Warrior
runners.spotlight: Made good start to chasing career in November, notably when winning at Doncaster (3m2f, soft); ran as though something was amiss there in December but has been given a two-month break and has possibilities if back on song for this hurdle return.

runners.comment: Good fourth over C&D in November and kept on stoutly to win at Fontwell on Boxing Day
runners.name: Kruger Park
runners.spotlight: Good fourth over C&D (soft) in November and outstayed next-time-out winner Jalisco Star when scoring at Fontwell (3m2f, good to soft) on Boxing Day; still on workable mark after latest 2lb rise; likely contender again.

runners.comment: Improving 6yo who commands respect on hat-trick attempt
runners.name: Call Me Legend
runners.spotlight: Improving novice who bids to complete a hat-trick after handicap wins at Exeter (2m7f, good to soft) and Wincanton (3m, heavy) this year; moves up in grade but still needs to taken very seriously.

13:50.race_name: Virgin Bet Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle (Go North Cab On Target Series Qualifier)

runners.comment: 0-14 but runner-up on nine occasions and could be in the mix now back down in trip
runners.name: Diamond Koda
runners.spotlight: 0-14 but runner-up on nine occasions and he ran well for a long way in first-time cheekpieces (retained) here (3m, good to soft) in December before fading into fifth; could be in the mix now back down in trip.

runners.comment: Disappointing at Catterick last time but runner-up at Wetherby previously; not written off
runners.name: Camarrate
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent and well beaten at Catterick (2m3f, good) in December last time; however, prior to that he ran well when second of six at Wetherby (2m3f, good); has shown promise on good to soft; not written off.

runners.comment: Promise in maiden/novice hurdles on last two starts and he has potential off opening mark
runners.name: Ryebridge
runners.spotlight: Clear second to subsequently useful sort in Hexham maiden (2m4f, good) last June and again showed promise when fourth of seven at Carlisle (2m1f, good) in October, when last seen; has potential off his opening mark.

runners.comment: Continues to drop down the weights but a long time since this 11yo has been competitive
runners.name: Raffertys Return
runners.spotlight: Five-time hurdle winner who continues to drop down the weights; however, it's a long time since this 11yo has been competitive.

runners.comment: 11-race maiden; below par when last seen but one to watch in the betting following a break
runners.name: Maggies Boy
runners.spotlight: 11-race maiden who was below par in maiden hurdles on his last two outings last summer; however, last spring's handicap/maiden form puts him in the picture; one to watch in the betting on his return from a break.

runners.comment: Lightly raced 10yo; pulled up/well beaten on her 2 runs this winter, after mammoth absence
runners.name: Rock On Cassie
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 10yo who won a maiden hurdle for Gordon Elliott in 2022; however, following a mammoth absence she's been pulled up/well beaten on her two outings this winter; others have less to prove.

runners.comment: Won at Huntingdon in November then close 7th there last time; could have a part to play
runners.name: Tigga Time
runners.spotlight: Won under Jamie Gambin at Huntingdon (2m4f, good) in November on second stable start and second outing since returning from long absence; seventh of nine at Huntingdon (2m4f, soft) since but beaten just under 4l and that was a warmer race than this; could have a part to play.

runners.breeder: Razza Del Sole Societa Agricola Srl
runners.comment: Well worth another go at this sort of trip given how he rallied at Lingfield last time
runners.name: Bridge
runners.spotlight: Faded when upped to 2m3f at Fontwell last month but he's well worth another go at this sort of trip based on how he rallied for fourth of five at Lingfield (2m, heavy) three weeks ago, after making a bad mistake two out; seems versatile ground-wise; he's one to be interested in.

runners.comment: Productive campaign last season (hurdles/Flat) but not at the same level more recently
runners.name: Easter Icon
runners.spotlight: Productive campaign last season over hurdles and on the Flat; however, tailed off towards the end of last year on last two hurdle starts and he wasn't at his best back on the Flat early this month.

runners.comment: Could have more to offer now in a h'cap; in calculations, especially if strong in betting
runners.name: Lake Tiberias
runners.spotlight: Third in sole bumper (good) and has also shown ability when sixth (albeit without threatening) on all three hurdle starts (1m7f-2m3f, good/soft); this half-brother to the useful Ahorsewithnoname could have more to offer now moving into handicaps; in calculations, especially if strong in betting.

runners.comment: Underwhelming last month; in top form previously; major player if leaving last time behind
runners.name: Jack Hoola
runners.spotlight: Underwhelming when mid-division at Catterick last month; however, he was in fine form previously, winning twice in the autumn (2m3f/2m4f, good/soft) and finishing second of 14 at Exeter (2m2f, soft) in December; major player if leaving last time behind.

runners.comment: 3rd to well-treated winner on handicap debut at Sedgefield and open to further improvement
runners.name: Peckforton Hills
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner who was well backed when third of five to well-treated winner on handicap debut at Sedgefield (2m4f, good to soft) recently; a tongue-tie is added to the cheekpieces adopted last time; open to further improvement and he's one to consider.

14:20.race_name: Virgin Bet Novices' Handicap Chase (Go North Forgive 'N Forget Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.breeder: Miss D Quigley & Mrs S OToole
runners.comment: 6l win on chase debut then flopped at Hereford, but could bounce back with bold show
runners.name: Noahsgreatrainbow
runners.spotlight: Listed bumper runner-up who showed improved form to win by 6l on his chase and handicap debut at Wincanton (2m4f, soft) in December; flopped at Hereford (2m5f, soft) subsequently but perhaps paid the price for chasing a strong pace and he could bounce back with a bold show.

runners.comment: Step back in right direction last time & this point winner could appreciate going chasing
runners.name: Sign Again
runners.spotlight: Hasn't fulfilled the promise shown when winning his first two hurdle starts in late 2024 but Sedgefield (2m4f, good to soft) in December was a step back in the right direction in a first-time tongue-tie (retained) and this point winner could be suited by the switch to fences; possible player.

runners.comment: There was some promise in his 3rd of 5 at Sandown and that race is working out very well
runners.name: Lylian
runners.owner: T Jacobs And Mrs E Avery
runners.spotlight: French chase winner (2m6f, soft) who hasn't threatened across his three British starts, and this expected return to better ground may be against him; however, there was some promise in his 14l third of five at Sandown (2m4f, soft) last time and that race is working out very well.

runners.comment: Won on chase debut here in December and could play a leading role now back here
runners.name: Cuban Court
runners.spotlight: Disappointing at Taunton (2m, good to soft) last month but reportedly unsuited by that tight track; prior to that he won here (2m, good to soft) on his chase debut, and his last two hurdle wins came over 2m3f; has a strong record at this course and could play a leading role now back here.

14:50.race_name: Virgin Bet Daily Extra Places Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Runner-up in C&D handicap two starts ago; looks vulnerable even if rediscovering that form
runners.name: Breezethroughlife
runners.spotlight: Won maiden hurdle at Fakenham (2m4f, good) in October and runner-up on handicap debut over this C&D (good to soft) in December; however, pulled up at Taunton since and looks vulnerable even if back to his best.

runners.comment: Won maiden at Plumpton in good style; every chance longer trip will suit; leading player
runners.name: Quay Item
runners.owner: Middleham Park Racing & M & L Sainsbury
runners.spotlight: Placed in both points (3m, good/yielding) and third of six on hurdle debut here (2m5f, good to soft) before winning a maiden at Plumpton (2m4f, soft) with something to spare; there's every chance today's longer trip will suit and he's a leading player.

runners.comment: Won maiden hurdle for Willie Mullins last May but tailed off on recent stable debut
runners.name: Sunset Boulevard
runners.spotlight: Won on hurdle debut for Willie Mullins at Tramore (2m6f, good to yielding) last May; however, others have more substance to their form and he tailed off at 50-1 on recent stable debut at Kempton (2m5f, good to soft).

runners.comment: Won on h'dle debut then contested Grade 2; strong claims now up in trip/back down in grade
runners.name: Tormund Giantsbane
runners.owner: Cherry Knoll Farm M Ward & D Skelton
runners.spotlight: Point (2m4f) and bumper winner who got off the mark at the first attempt over hurdles at Carlisle (2m4f, soft) in November; not disgraced when 12l fourth of five in Grade 2 at Sandown (2m4f, soft) since; there's stamina in his pedigree; strong claims now up in trip and back down in grade.

runners.comment: Limitations may again be exposed but receives weight all round and might not be far away
runners.name: Sleedagh
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on first three hurdle starts (2m4f/3m, soft/good to soft) before third of five in strong novice at Musselburgh (3m, good to soft) four weeks ago; suspicion his limitations may again be exposed today but he's receiving weight all round and might not be far away.

15:22.race_name: Virgin Bet Handicap Hurdle (Go North Sea Pigeon Series Qualifier)

runners.comment: Below best on the Flat lately but the return to hurdles/Doncaster could be a big plus
runners.name: Parramount
runners.spotlight: Unable to beat a rival on AW on last two starts but could be a different proposition now back hurdling and back here, as two visits to Doncaster (both C&D) have yielded an easy novice win (good) and a good second in a handicap (soft; in November); very much of interest given record at the track.

runners.breeder: G Durrheim And Maria Mulcahy Durrheim
runners.comment: Not the force of old but ran well off reduced mark last month and could be in the mix
runners.name: A Different Kind
runners.spotlight: 9yo who has returned from a long absence this season and hasn't recaptured his considerable 2023 promise, but he ran well when third off his reduced mark at Haydock (1m7f, good to soft) last month; has had wind surgery since and he could be in the mix.

runners.comment: Bumper/maiden hurdle winner who could have a part to play on today's handicap debut
runners.name: Minella Jury
runners.spotlight: Irish bumper winner (2m, yielding) who followed up on his hurdle/stable debut at Uttoxeter (2m, heavy) in December and again ran well when third over this C&D (soft) last month; he's had wind surgery ahead of today's handicap debut and this unexposed 6yo could have a part to play.

runners.comment: Bumper/maiden hurdle winner who begins handicap life on a fair mark and is not ruled out
runners.name: North Of Richmond
runners.spotlight: Soft-ground bumper winner who scored on his hurdle debut at Fakenham (2m, good to soft) in October and has shown similar form in defeat on next two starts (1m7f/2m, soft/good to soft); begins handicap life on a fair mark and he's not ruled out.

runners.comment: Second to highly progressive winner at Haydock last time and he's on the shortlist
runners.name: King Ulanda
runners.spotlight: Won on reappearance at Carlisle (2m1f, good) in October and has continued in good form, finishing second to a highly progressive winner at Haydock (1m7f, good to soft) in December last time; he's on the shortlist.

runners.comment: Won over C&D in December then didn't see out 2m4f at Wincanton last time; in with a chance
runners.name: Light Fandango
runners.spotlight: Won over C&D in December on second start back from a long absence then didn't see out 2m4f on soft ground at Wincanton last month; won on soft going in 2024; this lightly raced 7yo retains potential now back down in trip and he's in with a chance.

runners.comment: Fourth on handicap debut; optimism he has more left in the tank for his top stable
runners.name: Leaumec De Mee
runners.spotlight: Built upon previous promise on good/good to soft to win maiden hurdle at Sedgefield (2m1f, soft) in December; respectable fourth on handicap debut at Newbury (2m, good to soft) and there can be optimism this very lightly raced 5yo still has more left in the tank for his top stable.

runners.comment: Won on handicap debut over 1m7f on New Year's Day and faded over 2m5f next time
runners.name: Killycarn
runners.spotlight: Won on handicap debut at Catterick (1m7f, good) on New Year's Day and faded when sixth of 17 at Haydock (2m5f, good to soft) subsequently; retains potential now back down in trip and he's in with a chance.

runners.comment: Runner-up at Musselburgh four weeks ago and could be bang there once more
runners.name: As Fast As Wind
